scope: Original R1 raw bad-event energy route, with inner-only Hessian shortcut rejected and whole-outer-chart condition exposed. Parent unreviewed application in the already stated real near-flat fixed-step family; not total physical R1 suppression.

event_and_domains.Q1_preliminary: CMP1191.8 is the PRELIMINARY Q1 bad event for U U_(1,Pi)^(-1) on original free bonds in Pi enlarged2, threshold2delta0. Do not identify its variables/event with R1 by notation.
event_and_domains.R1_actual: The R1 decomposition1.18 is AFTER critical translation, linearization and Aphysical=g0*A raw rescaling. A bad R1 cube has an actual free bond in its stated test patch with ||A_b||_*>=r_raw=A1*p0(g0). It is not a whitened Gaussian variable.
event_and_domains.outer: The actual outer characteristic restrictions come from1.8 and the global/local background comparison. Source1.12 chooses the global constrained critical minimum; source249 leaves the FREE variables unchanged under selected linearization. On complete admitted source covers, principal logarithm bounds give ||g0 A_b||<=C_log*(2delta0+delta_bg)=u_outer for the same free variables.
event_and_domains.fixed_law: Use the EXACT declared delta0, A1*p0 and norms. The previously recorded incompatible printed prefactor identities are not repaired by selecting a favorable value. Bounding an existing outer domain is an estimation device, not changing the cutoff or integral.

rejected_inner_only_argument.reason: A Hessian margin only inside the INNER good product ||A_b||_*<r_raw cannot integrate along a segment to a bad R1 point outside that product. An energy barrier at first exit is not automatically a lower bound farther out. Mere minimality does not provide a quadratic radial cost there.
rejected_inner_only_argument.consequence: Do not cite1534 only at its old inner-domain scope as proof of R1 bad-event suppression.

whole_outer_repair.leading_action: Let F_g(A)=g0^-2 S_classical(g0 A,U1) on the ACTUAL selected reconstruction, including the source soft gauge, current/constraint curvature and all transported frames. Its classical gradient at0 vanishes. Haar/Jacobian logarithms are not silently included in that cancellation.
whole_outer_repair.same_prototype_mechanism: The1534 finite-prototype derivative estimate for the LEADING action applies on any smaller fixed prototype chart, not just the inner indicator. If the original outer free domain lies in the box sup||g0 A_b||<=u_outer inside that chart, the same row/column mean-value mechanism gives ||Hess F_g-Qflat||<=C_f*(r_background+u_outer). The nonlinear selected outputs are controlled by the same admitted prototype chart.
whole_outer_repair.margin: Under r_background+u_outer<=a_flat/(2*C_f) (with a harmless separate treatment of C_f=0), Hess F_g>=a_star I, a_star=a_flat/2, on the ENTIRE enclosing free box and every segment0 to A. Original delta0(g0)->0 and the exponentially small source comparison make this possible for sufficiently small coupling within the fixed chart, conditional on the same actual physical/frame/cover hypotheses. No numerical source threshold has been certified.
whole_outer_repair.energy: Then F_g(A)-F_g(0)>=a_star*||A||_2^2/2. For N_R bad cubes with witness multiplicity <=nu_R and norm conversion ||A_b||_2>=kappa_raw||A_b||_*, the actual raw event costs >=a_star*kappa_raw^2*r_raw^2*N_R/(2*nu_R). This is a FULL-action estimate, not a centered conditional probability.

means_and_density_costs.conditional_mean: The exterior mean in1.26 remains nonzero. The full action estimate includes the ORIGINAL exterior action and completing-square allocation, so it does not infer a centered conditional tail under arbitrary exterior data.
means_and_density_costs.logarithms: The complete negative log density generally has a nonzero linear derivative from Haar/Jacobian terms. A Hessian bound for it does not license setting its gradient to0. Keep these local density/current terms as declared interaction/count costs or pay their linear charge explicitly.
means_and_density_costs.normalization: Relative classical energy is not a normalizer lower bound or a bound on its reciprocal;1513/1.26 baseline and determinants remain once.
means_and_density_costs.support_gate: The full original free-variable cover, same critical/frame map and star-shaped enclosing chart must be verified for the intended source family. Arbitrary regular mixed-scale backgrounds are not automatically in the existing near-flat admitted chart.

combined_budget.R1_scaling: On the fixed logarithmic raw convention r_raw=A1*A0*q^p, its quadratic charge has order q^(2p). A fixed enlarged R1 patch has O(q^(4r)) sites, so the conservative count/log mechanism is the same p>=5r budget, conditional on matched actual constants and incidence.
combined_budget.no_double_payment: P0, P1 and R1 witnesses can consume overlapping original action. If one nonnegative original action budget independently dominates each proved charge E0,E1,ER, allocate fixed nonnegative theta0,theta1,thetaR with sum<=1; it then dominates theta0 E0+theta1 E1+thetaR ER. Do not add three full uses of the same action.
combined_budget.baseline_gate: For the R1 relative energy to be paid from the original nonnegative action, retain the original critical baseline and soft-gauge domain; do not silently subtract that baseline twice or identify a different action.

decision: An inner-good-region Gaussian/Hessian result alone does not close the original R1 bad sector. The whole-outer-chart leading-action route supplies an explicit conditional repair and avoids zero-mean substitution, but actual cover/frame/admissibility and combined budget remain to be checked. No new paper/review/score or global result.
falsifiers: Some original R1 point or segment to it leaves the admitted outer prototype chart
Actual outer characteristic functions fail to cover the required original free variables
The selected/current/frame map differs from the one used for the Hessian estimate
A logarithmic density gradient is discarded as if classical critical cancellation applied to it
Witness/patch incidence grows with volume or shared action is spent repeatedly
An unverified prefactor convention or new smaller cutoff is substituted to force the margin
